name: webapp-factory
description: A Claude Code plugin to spec, plan, implement and review web applications (front, API, database) with a disciplined, reviewed workflow.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: The workflow: /factory:factory-init sets up the project, then write-spec, write-plan, implement, grill-me and review run the spec → plan → code → review → close loop, driven by the project's factory.yaml manifest.
